## Problem

Describe the problem and link its issue with a closing keyword when applicable.

## Changes

Describe the resulting behavior and any deliberate limits.

## Validation

List commands, results, and any checks that could not run.

## Specification

Link the OpenSpec change, or explain why this does not change template behavior. For a template
change, keep this PR draft until the approved package is implemented. After validation, request
human acceptance; archive only when explicitly instructed.
